title: Adaptivity via a Parallel Architecture for Stochastic Gradient Methods
summary: Let $\mathrm{A}(x_0,y)$ be an algorithm with two inputs: an initial point $x_0$ and an integer parameter $y$, which specifies that $\mathrm{A}(.,.)$ executes at most $y$ iterations or steps. Given an integer $p\ge 1$, $p$ parallel processors search an appropriate value of $T$ for for $A(.)$. Each processor executes an infinite sequence of stages indexed by $i=0,1,2,\ldots$. At stage $i$, processor $j$ is assigned $T_{j,i}=h(j,i),$ where $h:\mathbb{N}\times\mathbb{N}\rightarrow\mathbb{R}^{+}$ is a prescribed function. Processor $j$ $(j=0,1,\ldots,p-1)$ then executes $\mathrm{A}(x_0,T_{j,i})$.…
